name: Budds Creek Motocross Park

soil.notes: Series page calls it deep, tacky soil. Analyst notes the insides of corners can pack too hard to use in dry years; a hard rain beforehand gives a soft base that hardens through the day.

layout.notes: Classic hills, jumps and off-cambers. Mostly one fast line; most corners favor the inside so passing is hard and starts matter. First turn often has bikes down.

conditions.dry: Insides of corners can get too hard-packed; passing very hard.
conditions.wet: Hard rain before the race soaks deep, giving traction on every line; can wash out the bottoms of downhills.
conditions.late_day: Soft base hardens as the day goes; ruts form but crews work them between motos.
conditions.seasonal: Pro national each August; hot and humid.

rider_reports.says: Analyst: Friday rain soaked in, gave grip on insides and outsides, and the base hardened over the day; washouts at bottoms of downhills; hard to pass.
Analyst: one fast line and inside-favoring corners make passing very hard even when dry; starts and first-turn survival matter; a freshly groomed first lap changes jump approach speed.
